That report is the deliverable of beadrs-e6adf893 and must survive until the downstream pin chain reads it - but beadrs-b722358e is contended (concurrent dispatches write its notes) and `bead update --notes` REPLACES the entire notes field, so one concurrent write can silently delete the report.

- Record on THIS bead's own notes (guarded with --if-revision): the beadrs-b722358e revision you read, intact-or-restored verdict, and the post-action re-read proof
- Do not create any file in the working tree; do not close beadrs-b722358e or any other bead
